chapter_mission: Ben arrives at Tarn Velos Coastal Detention Works, a storm-lashed industrial coastal prison. He moves through processing under his low-profile cover as a GA Justice records auditor and is shown to the visitor room. Talon is brought in. Talon enters as quick, funny, restless, and difficult. He recognizes the duplicated manifest fragment as a cloned shipment identity, not a clerical mistake, and clocks Ben as Skywalker, Jedi, and former GAG. His jokes test Ben, hide fear, and keep the visitor room from becoming solemn. Include a humanizing prison-habit beat: Talon sits where he can see the door, counts guards mid-joke, keeps his hands visible, pockets food automatically, or otherwise reveals how prison trained his body before he can hide it.
chapter_turn: The prison alarm changes pitch; Talon notices it is wrong.
